At Rockstar Games, we create world-class entertainment experiences.

Become part of a team working on some of the most rewarding, large-scale creative projects to be found in any entertainment medium - all within an inclusive, highly-motivated environment where you can learn and collaborate with some of the most talented people in the industry.

Rockstar North is on the lookout for a Tools Programmer who is passionate about supporting and further developing a world class audio tool suite.

This is a full-time, permanent and in-office position based in Rockstar’s state-of-the-art game development studio in Edinburgh, Scotland.

WHAT WE DO

• The Rockstar Audio Programming team is responsible for the technology that powers the sound effects, music and dialogue in our games.
• We’re committed to creating incredibly immersive interactive audio, pushing the sonic boundaries of what’s possible in our medium.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and maintain an in-house audio toolset, which supports the creation and implementation of audio assets found in-game.
• Closely collaborate with other members of the Audio team and the wider Rockstar Tools team.
• Maintain awareness of relevant technologies, modern UI standards, and drive their adoption within the toolset.
• Balance meeting short-term user needs with long-term development of the audio tool suite; identify opportunities to optimise user workflows.

REQUIREMENTS

• A degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Excellent .NET/C# skills.
• Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively within a mixed-discipline team.
• Ability to work within a schedule and deliver effectively to deadlines.

PLUSES

Please note that these are desirable skills and are not required to apply for the position.

• An interest in games and interactive sound/music.
• Familiarity with commercial audio content creation software.
• Experience of intuitive user interface design and implementation for complex data.
• Knowledge of audio synthesis and DSP.
• Experience with programming in C++.
• Experience building applications using WPF framework.

HOW TO APPLY

Please apply with a CV and cover letter demonstrating how you meet the skills above. If we would like to move forward with your application, a Rockstar recruiter will reach out to you to explain next steps and guide you through the process.

Rockstar is committed to creating a work environment that promotes equal opportunity, dignity and respect. jobs.description: Join CoolIT, an Ecolab Company, a global leader in Direct Liquid Cooling technology for data centers, supercomputers, and high-performance computing environments. This role leads financial system enhancements, reporting automation, NetSuite optimization, and process improvement initiatives while partnering with FP&A, Accounting, Revenue Management, Operations, and IT. Support the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and related financial applications. Develop and maintain financial reports, dashboards, saved searches, and analytics that improve visibility into business performance and support decision-making. Lead system enhancement initiatives, upgrades, testing efforts, and deployment of new functionality to support business growth, acquisition integration, U.S. GAAP compliance, and future SOX readiness. Identify and implement opportunities to automate manual financial and operational processes, reducing reliance on spreadsheets and improving efficiency. Support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, accounting, revenue management, and manufacturing accounting processes through system improvements and reporting solutions. Partner with FP&A, Accounting, Revenue Management, Operations, and IT teams to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable system solutions. Maintain system documentation, process maps, training materials, and provide end-user support and training. Monitor data integrity, reporting accuracy, and system controls to ensure reliable and consistent financial information. Participate in ERP, reporting, process improvement, and cross-functional business transformation projects. Position Details Reporting to the FP&A Manager, this role supports the Finance organization through financial systems administration, reporting, automation, and process improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, technical aptitude, business acumen, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex business problems, improving processes, and leveraging technology to drive efficiency and scalability. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in financial systems, FP&A, business analytics, financial reporting, or a related field. Experience working with ERP systems in support of finance, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, or business operations. Experience developing and maintaining financial reports, dashboards, analytics, or business intelligence solutions. Strong understanding of financial, accounting, and business processes. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large and complex datasets. Experience with SQL, Power Query, or other data analysis and reporting tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a dynamic and evolving environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience administering or supporting NetSuite ERP. Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Power BI or similar tools. Experience supporting ERP implementations, system upgrades, integrations, or enhancement projects. Experience with process automation, workflow design, and continuous improvement initiatives. Experience supporting manufacturing accounting processes, including work orders, inventory transactions, assemblies, and costing methodologies. Knowledge of U.S. GAAP, internal controls, SOX readiness, or acquisition integration activities. CPA designation or related financial certification. Experience creating training materials, process documentation, and end-user guides. We thank every candidate in advance; however, we will contact only those selected for an interview. Recognized as one of “The Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies 2023” by Financial Times and honored with the Deloitte Fast 50 Clean Technology award in 2022, as well as the Deloitte Fast 500 distinction in both 2021 and 2022, CoolIT's rapid growth is capturing global attention. 우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

지난 2021년부터 크래프톤은 우리가 가진 게임 제작역량을 새롭게 확장할 수 있는 영역이자 새로운 도전을 지속할 분야로 딥러닝을 제시하고 해당 분야 연구에 집중하고 있으며, 본격화를 위하여 핵심 인재 영입 등 적극적인 투자를 진행하고 있습니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]

크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 게임과 비게임 분야를 위한 자체 AI 핵심 기술을 연구 개발하여, 기존 사업의 경쟁력을 강화하는 동시에 AI 기술의 사업화를 지원하며 새로운 가치와 혁신을 창출합니다:

• Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.

[AI Research R&D]

[Foundation Model R&D]

Foundation Model Research 실은 AI Research 본부의 비전을 바탕으로 Multimodal LLM, World Model 등 Foundation Model 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여, 새로운 플레이 경험을 만드는 데 기여합니다.

• 텍스트, 이미지, 오디오, 게임 로그 등 다양한 데이터를 다루는 파운데이션 모델을 설계·구축합니다.

[AI for Games R&D]

AI for Games R&D 실은 AI 기능들을 실제 게임에 도입 가능한 형태로 변형하여 적용하는 R&D에 집중하고 있으며, 크게 아래의 3가지 분야에 대해 집중하고 있습니다.

• Applied AI Agents & Foundation Models
• LLM, SLM, VLM 등 Foundation Model을 활용하여 플레이어 및 게임 세계와 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 AI Agent를 연구개발합니다. Agent Architecture, Context Engineering, Tool Use, RAG, Evaluation, Inference Optimization등 최신 Applied AI 기술을 활용하여 AI Companion, NPC, 콘텐츠 생성 등 실제 게임 서비스에 적용 가능한 AI 시스템을 개발합니다.
• Reinforcement Learning (RL)
• 복잡한 게임 환경에서 스스로 학습하고 전략을 발전시키는 RL 기술을 연구합니다. 대규모 시뮬레이션, Self-play, Multi-Agent Learning, 정책 최적화 및 평가 기술을 통해 실제 게임에 적용 가능한 학습 시스템을 개발합니다.
• Machine Learning (ML)
• 플레이어 행동 분석, 추천, 예측, 이상 탐지 등 다양한 ML 기술을 연구·개발합니다. 대규모 데이터 처리부터 모델 학습, 평가, 배포 및 운영까지 End-to-End ML 시스템을 구축하여 게임 서비스의 품질과 운영 효율을 향상시킵니다.

[Culture Fit]

AI Research 본부 인원들은 다양한 프로젝트를 통하여 여러 분야의 팀원들과 교류하고 협업하며 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시할 수 있습니다. 나이 및 직급에 관계없이 자유롭게 의견을 개진하는 분위기가 장려됩니다. 다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 통·번역 등 언어적 장벽을 해소할 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

크래프톤의 AI 연구 조직에서는 다양한 연구 주제를 기반으로 게임 및 인터랙티브 콘텐츠에 적용 가능한 AI 기술을 연구합니다. 본 포지션은 지원자분의 연구 경험과 전문성을 바탕으로, 인터뷰 과정에서 적합한 연구 조직 및 프로젝트를 함께 논의한 후 최종 팀 배정이 이루어집니다.

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did we ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we’re collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar e-commerce industry from the ground up. We are one of the fastest-growing e-commerce companies that established an unparalleled reputation for being a dominant and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

The Commerce team is responsible for building next-generation cloud commerce systems that power pricing, billing, usage metering, and revenue generation for Coupang’s cloud platform. This team operates as the backbone of the cloud business, enabling accurate pricing, discounting, invoicing, and real-time usage visibility for customers.

The systems are highly scalable and event-driven, ingesting and processing massive volumes of data—including customer usage events and Kubernetes-driven infrastructure signals. As the platform scales from early-stage adoption to large-scale rollout, it is expected to handle exponentially growing workloads, potentially reaching hundreds of millions to billions of events, while maintaining high performance and reliability.

A key focus of this team is building financial-grade systems that ensure accuracy, consistency, and correctness in billing, pricing, and revenue computation. These systems must provide real-time insights to customers while guaranteeing precise accounting of usage and charges.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will act as a technical leader, translating complex business requirements into scalable architecture and distributed systems. You will design and build low-latency, high-throughput backend services that can support multi-tenant cloud environments, ensure reliability under rapid growth, and maintain strict correctness in revenue-critical workflows.

What You Will Do

• Design and build scalable backend systems for pricing, billing, and usage metering
• Develop event-driven architectures to process large volumes of real-time usage and infrastructure data
• Build systems that provide real-time visibility into customer usage and billing metrics
• Design components for rate cards, pricing plans, discounting, and multi-currency transactions
• Work on distributed systems that support exponential growth in customers and usage events
• Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and platform teams to build cloud-native commerce capabilities
• Ensure high levels of accuracy, reliability, and scalability in revenue-critical systems
• Contribute to architecture decisions and drive engineering best practices

Basic Qualifications

• 8+ years of backend engineering experience
• Strong proficiency in Java-based backend development
• Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
• Experience building event-driven architectures and distributed systems
• Experience designing and scaling high-throughput systems handling large volumes of events
• Experience working with AWS-managed databases (e.g., Aurora or similar OLTP systems)
• Familiarity with containerized systems and Kubernetes ecosystems
• Experience building real-time systems (e.g., usage tracking, billing, metering pipelines)
• Strong understanding of system design, scalability, and reliability principles
• Strong problem-solving skills with focus on efficiency and correctness
• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Golang for backend development
• Deep expertise in AWS ecosystem (compute, storage, distributed services)
• Experience designing large-scale event processing systems (hundreds of millions to billions of events)
• Experience building cloud commerce platforms, billing systems, or pricing engines
• Familiarity with real-time usage metering, invoicing, or revenue systems
• Experience working with Kubernetes-based observability signals (logs, infra events, metrics)
• Exposure to high-growth systems scaling from early stage to large production scale
• Experience building multi-tenant, customer-facing cloud platforms

Type of work model

• Hybrid / Onsite / Remote working
• Our Hybrid work model: Coupang hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration that acts a catalyst to enrich the experience of employees. Employees are required to work at least 3 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 2 days a week, depending on the role requirement. Some businesses may require more time in office due to nature of work.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Principal Product Manager - Technical to own the post-purchase experience for Alexa for Shopping (formerly Rufus), the conversational shopping AI used by hundreds of millions of customers every month. You will set the multi-year vision for how agentic AI redefines everything that happens after a customer buys: tracking a delivery, getting started with a new product, troubleshooting it when something stops working, finding the accessory that fits it, and reordering the refill before it runs out. Each of those is a page a customer has to go find today, and you will define what each becomes when an assistant handles it for them. Key job responsibilities You will own post-purchase strategy and roadmap, driving clarity where the problem and opportunity are not yet defined. You will envision what a great post-purchase experience is and how to measure it, then create the roadmap to deliver on that vision. You will shape how post-purchase works in an agentic setting, defining which delivery, support, return, and replenishment actions the assistant takes on a customer's behalf, how it earns the trust to take them, and identifying the AI capabilities that will become table stakes before they are obvious. You will own the surfaces where product ownership happens today, from Your Orders to the returns flow, and turn each completed purchase into the beginning of the next mission. You will partner closely with multiple engineering and science teams, as well as the Delivery Experience, Customer Service, and Selling Partner organizations whose data and workflows the experience depends on, and will drive the cross-organizational decisions to define and influence the future of shopping AI. About the team Our mission is to fundamentally change how customers shop on Amazon by leveraging the state of the art in AI. Every month, hundreds of millions of customers use Alexa for Shopping to help with shopping decisions. We are building a conversational shopping experience that understands what customers need, provides trustworthy and helpful responses, and makes the entire shopping journey effortless. We will build the best shopping AI in the world — and then do it again in the next sprint.
